Build `plaza-gate` from a fixed `post` box and moving `leaf` box. The leaf is 0.9 m wide, 0.06 m thick, and 2.1 m tall: its height derives from the standing 1.8 m SOLOIST visual-scale profile plus a chosen 0.3 m silhouette margin. This is a blocking proportion and does not claim passage or user clearance. The square post is 0.12 m wide and deep and shares the leaf height. Both parts bind one opaque dielectric `gate-finish` with sRGB base swatch `#6f746e`, metallic 0, roughness 0.82, no emission, and no texture. Stage the root on the far-edge z coordinate and derive x as half that edge's positive half extent, preserving the setting's screen-right sightline relation without embedding the current plaza size. Replacing the boxes is expected, but any replacement must preserve part identity, dimensions, ground contact, placement relation, finish zone, and articulation binding.

The prop root is the ground-contact point beneath the fixed post, positive Y is up, and the leaf and post occupy the stated metre extents from that root. Neutral front, side, and top views must expose the two-part hierarchy, one finish zone, shut silhouette, far-edge relation, and blocking-only proportion before any motion or shot uses it.

Place the leaf's pivot on its hanging edge, use positive Y as the hinge axis, bind the leaf mesh to the named `swing` node, and constrain its rotation from the identity quaternion through 100 degrees. The prop root and frame remain motion-invariant.

This hinge remains the sole writable region of the same two-box blocking proxy and reuses its prop root, fixed post, moving leaf, and one finish zone. Front, side, and top views at zero, 50, and 100 degrees must expose the hanging-edge pivot and fixed frame; detachment, penetration, or root motion falsifies the interface.

Inspect front, side, and top views at zero, 50, and 100 degrees beside the standing 1.8 m SOLOIST visual-scale reference. Confirm that post and leaf retain the single `#6f746e` finish without emission or texture. Fail if that finish diverges between parts, the leaf detaches from the hinge, the frame moves, geometry penetrates at the shut pose, the 0.3 m silhouette margin or overall proportion stops matching that reference, a view suggests functional passage clearance, or a proxy view implies a surrounding structure the settings do not contain.

The review set inspects the same fixed-post and moving-leaf hierarchy and blocking-proxy ceiling rather than defining another gate. It uses the ground-contact prop root, positive-Y hinge axis, metre extents, hanging-edge pivot, and far-edge placement owned by the preceding units.
